verdict.rationale: The quickstart documents official SDKs for all four requested languages: Python (pip), TypeScript (npm @turbopuffer/turbopuffer), Go (turbopuffer-go/v2) and Java (com.turbopuffer.client), each with full write/query samples. The official OpenAPI repo confirms these TypeScript, Python, Go and Java clients are first-party, generated from the spec, and the API overview describes behaviors the official clients handle automatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality and maturity across the languages.
